title: Held-animal signed wheel-velocity decoding from brain-wide spikes
scientific_question: How accurately can a source-trained method recover signed wheel velocity from simultaneous neural observations in 13 held animals, and how much does neural input add beyond the permitted experimental context?
primary_outputs: Original wheel_vel samples in the official emitted movement-window support; wheel_speed=abs(wheel_vel) is a separate companion target.

data_manifest.version: ibl_brain_wide_bench_2026; all_units versus selected_units builds must be specified

recording_contract.neural: brainsets HDF5 spike times/unit metadata; linear reference bins20ms then maps counts to targets
recording_contract.labels: TS1 choice,wheel and other behavior via published readout specifications; trial_id,values,timestamps,mask; anatomy and QC metadata
recording_contract.time_alignment: Readout uses trailing fixed1second target; context up to20seconds backed by split gaps; target-specific timestamps and masks
recording_contract.biological_ids: Session UUID/eid, subject metadata; publisher reports disjoint126/13animals
recording_contract.evidence: S3 H5manifest + AWSregistry + pinned task loader/baseline source

missing_or_unverified: No exact input asset record was extracted from the linked readiness manifest; inspect the pinned source audit before acquisition.
This specification does not establish a local public/private packet, payload equality or an executed task adapter.

inputs: All native spike times/unit identities within each original emitted window, with exact support and full anatomy/location metadata; no unit subsampling.
Permitted context and target timestamp offsets in matched C (context) and J (context plus neural) roles; source-session wheel labels for fitting only.
Signed velocity and speed are both predicted; the physical wheel-unit and sign convention must be independently admitted before data preparation.
forbidden_inputs: Evaluation-animal wheel labels, original target joins, source filenames or original biological IDs usable to retrieve targets.
All seven extra sessions from evaluation animals in source fitting or checkpoint lineage.
Processed wheel history until its causal/preprocessing status is separately qualified; future values and evaluator feedback.
allowed_inputs.case_identity: Preparation generates opaque 32-hex animal/session/window aliases and keeps original eid/trial/onset joins operator-private. Complete original roster is pinned; no authentic alias manifest was generated in this revision.
allowed_inputs.split: 423 sessions from 126 source animals with source-animal model-selection folds; 29 sessions from 13 disjoint evaluation animals. Every original supported emitted interval is retained. This is a custom held-animal estimator, not the official within-session TS1 aggregate.
allowed_inputs.coverage: 452 original session objects, all units, all emitted windows and all target timestamps required; actual counts depend on authentic preparation. The 24 workflow/input/tool/realization panels are conditions in this one task, not 24 benchmarks.

biological_unit: Animal: 13 evaluation animals; sessions, timestamps, model realizations and windows are nested.
case_definition: One emitted movement window with all original target timestamps, nested in session and animal.

split.policy: 423 sessions from 126 source animals with source-animal model-selection folds; 29 sessions from 13 disjoint evaluation animals. Every original supported emitted interval is retained. This is a custom held-animal estimator, not the official within-session TS1 aggregate.
split.coverage: 452 original session objects, all units, all emitted windows and all target timestamps required; actual counts depend on authentic preparation. The 24 workflow/input/tool/realization panels are conditions in this one task, not 24 benchmarks.

reference.role: Official task loader, linear predictive baseline and evaluator source; not run in this audit.

controls: Separate signed velocity from absolute speed; speed-only success cannot resolve movement direction.
Retain complete source/evaluation animal separation and the excluded seven-session lineage rule.
Report timing/context-only prediction and native clipping/target conventions independently.
Do not activate a wheel-history control by guessing a lag after noncausal preprocessing.

direct_observation.representation: Prospective no-tools response from a frozen complete numeric or raster representation of the same original neural window.
direct_observation.boundary: No fitting, external computation or target lookup; representation must preserve complete permitted support before comparison.
missing: No complete no-tools transport, response format or lossless feasible representation is supplied.

typed_viewer.representation: Prospective spike-raster/behavior-independent context viewer with typed channel/time navigation.
typed_viewer.boundary: Rendered observations only; no raw arrays, target traces or arbitrary compute return.
missing: No typed renderer/action transport or matched target-coverage validation.

tool_assisted.representation: Current I workflow may investigate one evaluation animal's permitted unlabeled observations with matched generic or supplied trained tools.
tool_assisted.boundary: Fresh animal/condition context, no evaluation labels or cross-condition state; comparison is workflow-level and tool-aware.
missing: Actual input provisioning, provider/tool isolation and full execution qualification.

frozen_program.representation: Current F workflow commits general source and fitting/adaptation recipe before evaluation access.
frozen_program.boundary: Source-only fitting and model selection; inference sees the exact allowed unlabeled evaluation observations and retained state.
missing: Complete source-data/reference execution and audited participant runtime.

primary.name: Signed-velocity animal-macro R-squared
primary.aggregation: Equal timestamp weight within each window, equal windows within each session, equal sessions within animal, then equal animals. Retain negative R-squared; any required constant-target animal leaves the primary aggregate undefined.
primary.rationale: Measures reconstruction of measured continuous signed behavior and prevents long sessions or many windows from masquerading as more animals.

secondary: MSE, MAE, per-animal support and signed paired neural-minus-context and workflow/tool differences.
Native-convention metric is a separate diagnostic and must not replace the canonical animal-macro estimator.

comparators.name: Context-only C
comparators.inputs: Same admitted context, offsets and anatomy summaries; no spikes.
comparators.procedure: Run matched C/J role policies with identical whole-panel budget and source folds; do not deliberately weaken C.

comparators.name: Normalized ridge, 512-tree ExtraTrees and set/context neural-network references
comparators.inputs: Full selected source observations with training-only representation fitting.
comparators.procedure: Use the fixed source reference families, full source-fold selection and full-source refits; empirical competence has not been measured.

comparators.name: T0 versus supplied source-trained tool T1
comparators.inputs: Matched C/J view and frozen trained reference state when separately admitted.
comparators.procedure: Keep generic tools, supplied decoder alone and agent-plus-decoder outcomes distinguishable; pretrained exposure and preparation cost remain declared.

nuisance_controls: Separate signed velocity from absolute speed; speed-only success cannot resolve movement direction.
Retain complete source/evaluation animal separation and the excluded seven-session lineage rule.
Report timing/context-only prediction and native clipping/target conventions independently.
Do not activate a wheel-history control by guessing a lag after noncausal preprocessing.
evaluation.uncertainty: Use 13 paired animal effects. Source implements 10,000 fixed-seed animal bootstrap draws averaged over three realized policies; these are descriptive conditional on fitted references and realized policies, without refitting or a population/causal guarantee.
evaluation.failure_policy: Every original required animal, session, window, head and timestamp must be present exactly once and finite. Missing support, shape mismatch, nonfinite predictions or failed source admission cannot be scored by dropping cases; exact constant targets remain explicit undefined endpoints.
